guidelines.H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-outfit font-black tracking-tight
guidelines.H2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-outfit font-bold tracking-tight
guidelines.labels: text-xs font-outfit font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-slate-500

typography.instructions: Use 'Outfit' for all strong numerical stats, prices, and headings. Use 'Nunito' for long-form text, descriptions, and rules to keep it highly accessible for younger users.

colors.guidelines: Never use pure white/black. Backgrounds should feel like matte cardstock. Reserve the Primary Red for main actions (Scanning, Adding to Collection) and Accent Yellow for highlights (Holos, Milestones).

trading_cards.classes: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] border border-slate-200/60 overflow-hidden

holo_foil_effect.description: For 'Holo' or 'Reverse Holo' variants, apply a shimmering overlay.
holo_foil_effect.implementation: Use the iridescent plastic texture from media_and_images as an absolute overlay. Apply `mix-blend-color-dodge` or `mix-blend-screen` with `opacity-50`. Animate background position on hover to simulate shining foil.

scanner_reticle.active_scan: Use framer-motion to animate a glowing red line dropping top to bottom continuously.

layouts_and_spacing.app_structure: Mobile-first bottom navigation paradigm. 1 column on mobile, transitioning to a dense dashboard/sidebar on desktop.
layouts_and_spacing.collection_grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-3 sm:gap-6
layouts_and_spacing.dashboard_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6. Use col-span-2 for primary charts, col-span-1 for summary stats.
layouts_and_spacing.detail_view: Instead of full page navigation for cards, use Shadcn Sheet (Bottom Drawer on mobile, Right Drawer on desktop) to allow rapid scanning and adding without losing grid context.
layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing around structural elements (p-6 to p-8), but tight spacing inside cards (p-3 to p-4) to maximize artwork size.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons should be solid Primary Red with a subtle bottom-heavy shadow to feel 'pressable'.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults but rounded-xl with bg-slate-50, border-slate-200. High contrast focus rings (focus:ring-primary_red).
components.progress_bars: Thick (h-4 or h-6) with rounded-full ends. Use gradient fills (e.g., Yellow to Red) for set completion milestones to make it exciting for kids.
components.badges: Use brightly colored pills for Card Types (Fire, Water, etc.) with dark text for contrast if needed.
components.filters: Horizontal scrollable chips (facets) for Type, Set, Rarity. Do not hide all filters in a dropdown; expose the most common ones.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide-up (10px) using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.list_stagger: When loading the card grid, stagger the entrance of cards by 0.05s.
motion_and_interactions.haptic_feedback: Visually simulate haptic feedback by scaling buttons down (scale-95) on active/tap state.
motion_and_interactions.celebration: When a 'Goal' or 'Set' is completed, or a highly valuable card is scanned, use tsParticles for a burst of confetti or stars.

holographic_texture.usage: Use as an overlay with mix-blend-mode for Holo card variants to simulate shiny foil.

playful_background.usage: Use as a blurred, low-opacity background for onboarding, empty states, or login screens.

scanner_placeholder.usage: Use as a fallback background for the scanner page before camera permission is granted, heavily darkened (bg-black/80).

iconography.style: Use stroke-width 2.5 for a slightly bolder, friendlier appearance suitable for kids. Primary icons (Scan, Collection) in the bottom nav should be slightly larger (w-6 h-6).

general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Do not use transparent backgrounds under text. Use 'Outfit' for numbers to prevent tabular figure shifting.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.target_audience_bridge: To serve both adults and a 7-year-old: Keep the data (prices, set numbers) present but secondary. Make the card art and set logos the primary visual hierarchy. Use color-coded type badges which kids recognize instantly.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactable elements. Especially crucial for the 'Add to Collection' plus buttons on the grid.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.data_testid: ALL interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on their role (e.g., data-testid='scan-camera-btn', data-testid='card-item-charizard').

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React, Tailwind, Shadcn UI, Framer Motion.
implementation_steps: 1. Setup Tailwind config with custom colors (primary_red, accent_yellow) and fonts (Outfit, Nunito).
2. Build the structural layout: Bottom Navigation for Mobile, Sidebar for Desktop.
3. Create the 'TradingCard' component with Holo variants (using the provided holographic_texture with mix-blend-color-dodge).
4. Implement the Scanner UI: Camera viewport with a targeted 'Tracing Beam' overlay.
5. Build the Sets Dashboard: Progress bars and bento-grid stats.
6. Ensure the Detail Sheet (Drawer) opens quickly for fast batch-adding.
crucial_rules: DO NOT center align text paragraphs. Left align for readability.
DO NOT use raw HTML `<select>`. Use Shadcn Select or horizontal scrolling chips for filters.
ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover states.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds behind text. Use backdrop-blur with a semi-solid color.
USE framer-motion for smooth sheet openings and scanning beam animations.
